verses.am: በእንግዳም አምላክ እርዳታ በጽኑ አምባ ላይ ያደርጋል፤ ለሚያውቁት ክብር ያበዛላቸዋል፥ በብዙም ላይ ያስገዛቸዋል፥ ምድርንም በዋጋ ይከፍላል።

verses.en: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.
verses.fr: Au temps de la fin, le roi du midi se heurtera contre lui. Et le roi du septentrion fondra sur lui comme une tempête, avec des chars et des cavaliers, et avec de nombreux navires; il s''avancera dans les terres, se répandra comme un torrent et débordera.
verses.am: በፍጻሜ ዘመንም የደቡብ ንጉሥ ከእርሱ ጋር ይዋጋል፤ የሰሜንም ንጉሥ ከሰረገሎችና ከፈረሰኞች ከብዙም መርከቦች ጋር እንደ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ይመጣበታል፤ ወደ አገሮችም ይገባል፥ ይጐርፍማል፥ ያልፍማል።

verses.en: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.
verses.fr: Il entrera dans le plus beau des pays, et plusieurs succomberont; mais Edom, Moab, et les principaux des enfants d''Ammon seront délivrés de sa main.
verses.am: ወደ መልካሚቱም ምድር ይገባል፥ ብዙ አገሮችም ይወድቃሉ፤ ነገር ግን ኤዶምያስና ሞዓብ ከአሞንም ልጆች የበለጡት ከእጁ ይድናሉ።

verses.en: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.
verses.fr: Il étendra sa main sur divers pays, et le pays d''Egypte n''échappera point.
verses.am: እጁን በአገሮች ላይ ይዘረጋል፥ የግብጽም ምድር አታመልጥም።

verses.en: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.
verses.fr: Il se rendra maître des trésors d''or et d''argent, et de toutes les choses précieuses de l''Egypte; les Libyens et les Ethiopiens seront à sa suite.
verses.am: በወርቅና በብርም መዝገብ ላይ፥ በከበረችም በግብጽ ዕቃ ሁሉ ላይ ይሠለጥናል፤ የልብያና የኢትዮጵያ ሰዎችም ይከተሉታል።

verses.en: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.
verses.fr: Des nouvelles de l''orient et du septentrion viendront l''effrayer, et il partira avec une grande fureur pour détruire et exterminer des multitudes.
verses.am: ከምሥራቅና ከሰሜን ግን ወሬ ያውከዋል፤ ብዙ ሰዎችንም ይገድል ዘንድና ፈጽሞ ያጠፋ ዘንድ በታላቅ ቍጣ ይወጣል።

verses.en: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.
verses.fr: Il dressera les tentes de son palais entre les mers, vers la glorieuse et sainte montagne Puis il arrivera à la fin, sans que personne lui soit en aide.
verses.am: ንጉሣዊ ድንኳኑንም በባሕርና በከበረው በቅዱስ ተራራ መካከል ይተክላል፤ ወደ ፍጻሜው ግን ይመጣል፥ ማንም አይረዳውም።

verses.en: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là se lèvera Micaël, le grand chef, le défenseur des enfants de ton peuple; et ce sera une époque de détresse, telle qu''il n''y en a point eu de semblable depuis que les nations existent jusqu''à cette époque. En ce temps-là, ceux de ton peuple qui seront trouvés inscrits dans le livre seront sauvés.
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን ስለ ሕዝብህ ልጆች የሚቆመው ታላቁ አለቃ ሚካኤል ይነሣል፤ ሕዝብም ከሆነ ጀምሮ እስከዚያ ዘመን ድረስ እንደ እርሱ ያለ ያልሆነ የመከራ ዘመን ይሆናል፤ በዚያም ዘመን በመጽሐፉ ተጽፎ የተገኘው ሕዝብህ ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ ይድናል።

verses.en: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
verses.fr: Plusieurs de ceux qui dorment dans la poussière de la terre se réveilleront, les uns pour la vie éternelle, et les autres pour l''opprobre, pour la honte éternelle.
verses.am: በምድርም ትቢያ ውስጥ ካንቀላፉቱ ብዙዎች ይነቃሉ፤ እኵሌቶቹ ወደ ዘላለም ሕይወት፥ እኵሌቶቹም ወደ እፍረትና ወደ ዘላለም ጕስቍልና።

verses.en: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
verses.fr: Ceux qui auront été intelligents brilleront comme la splendeur du ciel, et ceux qui auront enseigné la justice, à la multitude brilleront comme les étoiles, à toujours et à perpétuité.
verses.am: ጥበበኞቹም እንደ ሰማይ ፀዳል፥ ብዙ ሰዎችንም ወደ ጽድቅ የሚመልሱ እንደ ከዋክብት ለዘላለም ይደምቃሉ።

verses.en: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.
verses.fr: Toi, Daniel, tiens secrètes ces paroles, et scelle le livre jusqu''au temps de la fin. Plusieurs alors le liront, et la connaissance augmentera.
verses.am: ዳንኤል ሆይ፥ አንተ ግን እስከ ፍጻሜ ዘመን ድረስ ቃሉን ዝጋ፥ መጽሐፉንም አትም፤ ብዙ ሰዎች ይመረምራሉ፥ እውቀትም ይበዛል።

verses.en: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river.
verses.fr: Et moi, Daniel, je regardai, et voici, deux autres hommes se tenaient debout, l''un en deçà du bord du fleuve, et l''autre au delà du bord du fleuve.
verses.am: እኔም ዳንኤል አየሁ፤ እነሆም፥ ሁለት ሌሎች ቆመው ነበር፥ አንዱ በዚህ በወንዙ ዳር፥ ሌላውም በዚያ በወንዙ ዳር።

verses.en: And one said to the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?
verses.fr: L''un d''eux dit à l''homme vêtu de lin, qui se tenait au-dessus des eaux du fleuve: Quand sera la fin de ces prodiges?
verses.am: አንዱም ከወንዙ ውኃ በላይ የነበረውን በፍታም የለበሰውን። የዚህ ድንቅ ፍጻሜ እስከ መቼ ነው? አለው።

verses.en: And I heard the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and sware by him that liveth for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.
verses.fr: Et j''entendis l''homme vêtu de lin, qui se tenait au-dessus des eaux du fleuve; il leva vers les cieux sa main droite et sa main gauche, et il jura par celui qui vit éternellement que ce sera dans un temps, des temps, et la moitié d''un temps, et que toutes ces choses finiront quand la force du peuple saint sera entièrement brisée.
verses.am: ከወንዙም ውኃ በላይ የነበረው በፍታም የለበሰው ሰው ቀኝና ግራ እጁን ወደ ሰማይ አንሥቶ። ለዘመንና ለዘመናት ለዘመንም እኵሌታ ነው፤ የተቀደሰውም ሕዝብ ኃይል መበተን በተጨረሰ ጊዜ ይህ ሁሉ ይፈጸማል ብሎ ለዘላለም ሕያው ሆኖ በሚኖረው ሲምል ሰማሁ።

verses.en: And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what shall be the end of these things?
verses.fr: J''entendis, mais je ne compris pas; et je dis: Mon seigneur, quelle sera l''issue de ces choses?
verses.am: ሰማሁም ነገር ግን አላስተዋልሁም፤ የዚያን ጊዜም። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ የዚህ ሁሉ ፍጻሜ ምንድር ነው? አልሁ።

verses.en: And he said, Go thy way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Va, Daniel, car ces paroles seront tenues secrètes et scellées jusqu''au temps de la fin.
verses.am: እርሱም እንዲህ አለኝ። ዳንኤል ሆይ፥ ቃሉ እስከ ፍጻሜ ዘመን ድረስ የተዘጋና የታተመ ነውና ሂድ፤

verses.en: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.
verses.fr: Plusieurs seront purifiés, blanchis et épurés; les méchants feront le mal et aucun des méchants ne comprendra, mais ceux qui auront de l''intelligence comprendront.
verses.am: ብዙ ሰዎች ሰውነታቸውን ያጠራሉ ያነጡማል ይነጥሩማል፤ ክፉዎች ግን ክፋትን ያደርጋሉ፤ ክፉዎችም ሁሉ አያስተውሉም፥ ጥበበኞች ግን ያስተውላሉ።

verses.en: And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that maketh desolate set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.
verses.fr: Depuis le temps où cessera le sacrifice perpétuel, et où sera dressée l''abomination du dévastateur, il y aura mille deux cent quatre-vingt-dix jours.
verses.am: የዘወትሩም መሥዋዕት ከቀረ ጀምሮ፥ የጥፋትም ርኵሰት ከቆመ ጀምሮ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ዘጠና ቀን ይሆናል።

verses.en: Blessed is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.
verses.fr: Heureux celui qui attendra, et qui arrivera jusqu''à mille trois cent trente-cinq jours!
verses.am: የሚታገሥ፥ እስከ ሺህ ሦስት መቶ ሠላሳ አምስት ቀንም የሚደርስ ምስጉን ነው።

verses.en: But go thou thy way till the end be: for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days.
verses.fr: Et toi, marche vers ta fin; tu te reposeras, et tu seras debout pour ton héritage à la fin des jours.
verses.am: አንተ ግን እስከ ፍጻሜው ድረስ ሂድ፤ አንተም ታርፋለህ፥ በቀኑም መጨረሻ በዕጣ ክፍልህ ትቆማለህ።
